items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] John Casimir was scared to death of that stuff. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah? Oh yeah, you didn't know that? No, I didn't know that.

ctx.x: You see, he wouldn't stay there long after he'd sell them shoes. He'd go and train and go on somewhere else, you see. He had an old conny little trick. Some of them fellas would be lucky too when he sell them beans to that. They was going to be lucky anyhow, you see. He'd hit a stream of luck and slash that bean down there. These fellas used to be terrible with that stuff around there. They ain't so bad, no.

John Casimir was scared to death of that stuff. Yeah? Oh yeah, you didn't know that? No, I didn't know that. Oh man, I saw Thomas Jefferson kid him one day at a parade. You know, make those motions like he was going to throw something on him. And Casimir was scared to death. He practically quit playing and it was his band.

We had a fella in Mississippi, we used to call him See Me Now. You know, why we give him that name? You know, comedian fellas is funny, you know. They see fellas do something funny and they make something out of it. This fella come up one day, they used to get passes, you see. Bring their sweetheart to the show or something like that. You get a pass, you could bring his gun, you see. Well, this was one of the canvas boys, you know. People was kind of scared of him too, said he was a fool. He always was fooling…
